column1: # Deskripsi SKILL — putaran keenam puluh lima ekor panjang.

# --- serangan ---
=At the start of the next turn, deals AoE <color=#e67129>Burn damage</color> equal to <color=#f26c1c>100%</color> of attack that ignores Cover to all enemy targets within range.

column1: =Selects 1 direction and deals AoE <color=#42cce0>Freeze damage</color> equal to <color=#f26c1c>60%</color> of attack to all enemy targets within a <color=#f26c1c>3x5 area</color> in the selected direction, destroying any destructible Cover outside a <color=#f26c1c>3x3 area</color> around self.
column2: Memilih 1 arah lalu memberikan AoE <color=#42cce0>Freeze damage</color> setara <color=#f26c1c>60%</color> Attack ke semua target musuh dalam <color=#f26c1c>area 3x5</color> ke arah yang dipilih, sambil menghancurkan Cover yang bisa dihancurkan di luar <color=#f26c1c>area 3x3</color> di sekitar diri.

column1: =Deals AoE Physical damage to the last enemy that acted on this turn and all enemies within a <color=#f26c1c>3x3 area</color> around them.
column2: Memberikan AoE Physical damage ke musuh yang terakhir bergerak pada giliran ini dan semua musuh dalam <color=#f26c1c>area 3x3</color> di sekitarnya.

column1: =At the start of its turn, it locks onto the <color=#f26c1c>2</color> enemies with the <color=#f26c1c>highest HP</color> and <color=#f26c1c>lowest HP</color>, then deals AoE Physical damage equal to <color=#f26c1c>50%</color> of attack to <color=#f26c1c>the targets and all enemy units within 2 tiles of the targets</color>.
column2: Di awal gilirannya, dia mengunci <color=#f26c1c>2</color> musuh dengan <color=#f26c1c>HP tertinggi</color> dan <color=#f26c1c>HP terendah</color>, lalu memberikan AoE Physical damage setara <color=#f26c1c>50%</color> Attack ke <color=#f26c1c>target-target itu dan semua unit musuh dalam 2 tile dari mereka</color>.

column1: =At the start of its turn, it locks onto the <color=#f26c1c>2</color> enemies with the <color=#f26c1c>highest HP</color> and <color=#f26c1c>lowest HP</color>, then deals AoE Physical damage to <color=#f26c1c>the targets and all enemy units within 2 tiles of the targets</color>.
column2: Di awal gilirannya, dia mengunci <color=#f26c1c>2</color> musuh dengan <color=#f26c1c>HP tertinggi</color> dan <color=#f26c1c>HP terendah</color>, lalu memberikan AoE Physical damage ke <color=#f26c1c>target-target itu dan semua unit musuh dalam 2 tile dari mereka</color>.

column1: =Randomly selects <color=#f26c1c>one</color> enemy target and jumps to an adjacent tile of it, dealing melee AoE Physical damage equal to <color=#f26c1c>100%</color> of attack to it and all enemy units within <color=#f26c1c>2 tiles</color> of it, applies <color=#3487e0>{0}</color>, and generates <color=#e67129>Burn tiles</color>.

column2: Setelah itu, melengkungkan serangannya ke Doll musuh terdekat <color=#f26c1c>dalam area 3 tile</color>.

column1: =Whenever an enemy unit gains <color=#f26c1c>5 stacks</color> of <color=#3487e0>{0}</color>, then at the end of its action, deals AoE <color=#e67129>Burn damage</color> equal to <color=#f26c1c>100%</color> of attack to the target and within <color=#f26c1c>the 3x3 area around it</color>, and generates <color=#3487e0>{1}</color>.
column2: Setiap kali unit musuh mendapatkan <color=#f26c1c>5 stack</color> <color=#3487e0>{0}</color>, di akhir aksinya, memberikan AoE <color=#e67129>Burn damage</color> setara <color=#f26c1c>100%</color> Attack ke target dan <color=#f26c1c>area 3x3 di sekitarnya</color>, lalu menghasilkan <color=#3487e0>{1}</color>.

column2: Berikan <color=#e67129>Burn damage</color>, setelah menyerang, pulihkan HP target sekutu terdekat (kecuali pengguna).

column1: =Upon death, if the user is standing on a neutral or enemy Freeze tile, deals fixed damage equal to <color=#f26c1c>30%</color> of max HP to all allied units within <color=#f26c1c>3 tiles</color>.

column1: =Selects 1 tile within a <color=#f26c1c>cross-shaped area of 4 to 8 tiles</color>, landing on the selected tile, applying <color=#3487e0>{1}</color> and <color=#3487e0>{2}</color>, and dealing AoE <color=#8679e8>Corrosion damage</color> to all enemy targets in a path <color=#f26c1c>5 tiles wide</color>.
column2: Memilih 1 tile dalam <color=#f26c1c>area berbentuk silang seluas 4 sampai 8 tile</color>, mendarat di tile terpilih, menerapkan <color=#3487e0>{1}</color> dan <color=#3487e0>{2}</color>, lalu memberikan AoE <color=#8679e8>Corrosion damage</color> ke semua target musuh di jalur <color=#f26c1c>selebar 5 tile</color>.

=At the start of each action, for every <color=#f26c1c>2 points</color> of Confectance Index, gains <color=#f26c1c>1</color> random buff until the end of the action.
column2: Di awal setiap aksi, untuk setiap <color=#f26c1c>2 poin</color> Confectance Index, mendapatkan <color=#f26c1c>1</color> buff acak sampai aksi itu berakhir.

column1: =At the start of each action, gains random buffs based on the current Confectance Index.
column2: Di awal setiap aksi, mendapatkan buff acak berdasarkan Confectance Index saat itu.

column1: =Damage dealt to URNC mechanical units increases.
column2: Damage ke unit mekanis URNC meningkat.

column1: =Increases critical rate based on the number of debuffs on the target.
column2: Menambah Critical Rate berdasarkan jumlah debuff pada target.

column1: =Damage dealt is increased based on the number of instances of damage taken and the number of targets hit.
column2: Damage yang diberikan meningkat berdasarkan berapa kali menerima damage dan jumlah target yang terkena.

column1: =Attacks which do not exploit a phase weakness have their damage reduced.
column2: Serangan yang tidak mengeksploitasi kelemahan fase damage-nya berkurang.

column2: Saat Stability lebih dari <color=#f26c1c>0</color>, mengubah tipe damage unit sekutu jadi <color=#e67129>Burn damage</color>.

column1: =When taking Freeze damage from active attacks, takes additional fixed stability damage and gains <color=#3487e0>{1}</color>.

column1: =For <color=#f26c1c>each</color> stack of <color=#3487e0>{0}</color> possessed, attacks from ally units ignore <color=#f26c1c>5%</color> of the target's defense.

column1: =When attacking a target with <color=#3487e0>{2}</color> or <color=#3487e0>{3}</color>, ignores part of their stability index and deals increased damage.

column1: =When attacking a target with <color=#3487e0>{2}</color> or <color=#3487e0>{3}</color>, ignores part of their stability index and deals increased damage; if Freeze damage is dealt, ignores even more stability index.
